title: Shock absorber
object: Monotube gas-charged automotive damper (de Carbon type) in axial section
idea: Smoothing a noisy input: the suspension as a low-pass filter
summary: A quarter car drives over a speed hump on a rough road. The oil is forced through the piston ports and bends the shim stacks, which is why the force–velocity curve is steep at low speed and flattens past the knee; the nitrogen behind the floating piston takes up the rod's volume and keeps the oil from cavitating. With the valves bypassed the body keeps bouncing, so the two passes on the body chart show what the damper filters out.
usedFor: Vehicle dynamics teaching: quarter-car model, damping ratio, digressive valving
Product documentation for dampers and suspension components
Explaining low-pass filtering and exponential smoothing with a physical object
controls: Drag the rod eye · ↑ ↓ stroke · Space drives over a hump · D damping on/off · S slow motion
